title: New Football Quiz App - Wikiball
author: oscarno8
selftext:
Hey all 👋⚽

Not sure if this is allowed, so admins, feel free to chop it if it’s against the rules!

I’ve just launched Wikiball, a new football quiz game on iOS, and I’d love to get it in front of a few fellow football fans 📱

The idea is simple: can you name the player from their Wikipedia career history? 🧠

You’ll see the clubs they’ve played for and try to work out who connects the dots. Sounds easy… until you’re staring at a career path you’re convinced you recognise 😂

Along the way, you can:

🃏 Collect player cards  
🏆 Earn trophies and awards  
📈 Work your way up through the tiers  
🤝 Team up with your mates  
⚔️ Play against them for bragging rights  
❤️ Set your favourite club and test yourself on its players

If you reckon you know your club inside out, that last one might put you to the test 👀

It’s free to download, and you can earn free coins by completing your profile, playing and sharing the game 🪙

I’d love for you to give it a go and let me know what you think. Whether it’s something you enjoy, something that needs work, or an idea you’d like to see added, honest feedback would be really appreciated 🙌

Tag the mate who reckons they’re a walking football encyclopaedia and see how they get on 😂⚽

Download Wikiball here 👇  
https://apps.apple.com/au/app/wikiball/id6823594268

Cheers, everyone!
